title: Vazúza and Vólga
year_evidence: 扉の裏に『First Published October 1915 / Second Impression September 1916』
text:
The Vólga and the Vazúza had a long argument whether who was the wiser
and the stronger and the more honourable of the two. They contended and
quarrelled, and could not decide it. So they resolved at last: “Let us
both go to sleep at the same time, and the one which wakes up earlier
and first reaches the Khvalýnsk Sea is wiser and stronger and the more
honourable.”

So the Vólga went to sleep, and so did the Vazúza.

But at night the Vazúza got up quietly and ran away from the Vólga; she
took the next nearest way and flowed off.

When the Vólga woke up she went neither hurriedly nor lagging, but in an
ordinary fashion. At Zubtsov she overtook the Vazúza, and looked so
threatening that the Vazúza was frightened, and owned she was the
younger daughter, and begged the Vólga to take her in her arms into the
Sea of Khvalýnsk.

And, to this day, the Vazúza wakes up in the spring before the Vólga,
and wakes the Vólga up out of her winter sleep.
paragraphs: The Vólga and the Vazúza had a long argument whether who was the wiser and the stronger and the more honourable of the two. They contended and quarrelled, and could not decide it. So they resolved at last: “Let us both go to sleep at the same time, and the one which wakes up earlier and first reaches the Khvalýnsk Sea is wiser and stronger and the more honourable.”
So the Vólga went to sleep, and so did the Vazúza.
But at night the Vazúza got up quietly and ran away from the Vólga; she took the next nearest way and flowed off.

When the Vólga woke up she went neither hurriedly nor lagging, but in an ordinary fashion. At Zubtsov she overtook the Vazúza, and looked so threatening that the Vazúza was frightened, and owned she was the younger daughter, and begged the Vólga to take her in her arms into the Sea of Khvalýnsk.
And, to this day, the Vazúza wakes up in the spring before the Vólga, and wakes the Vólga up out of her winter sleep.
ヴォルガとヴァズーザは、二人のうちどちらが賢く、強く、誉れ高いかで長いあいだ言い争っていた。張り合い、けんかをしても、決着がつかなかった。そこでとうとう二人は決めた。「二人いっしょに眠りにつきましょう。先に目を覚まして、先にフヴァルィンスクの海へたどり着いたほうが、賢くて強くて誉れ高いのです」
そうしてヴォルガは眠りにつき、ヴァズーザも眠りについた。
ところが夜のうちに、ヴァズーザはそっと起き出してヴォルガのもとから逃げ、いちばん近い道を選んで流れ去った。
ヴォルガは目を覚ますと、急ぎもせず遅れもせず、いつもの調子で流れていった。ズプツォフでヴァズーザに追いつき、たいそう恐ろしい顔をしてみせたので、ヴァズーザはおびえ、自分は妹なのだと認めて、フヴァルィンスクの海まで腕に抱いて連れていってくれるようヴォルガに頼んだ。
そういうわけで今でも、春になるとヴァズーザはヴォルガより先に目を覚まし、ヴォルガを冬の眠りから起こすのである。
